_about: Rules mapping study conditions to our RTT treatment functions. Each rule is a case-insensitive regular expression tried against MeSH terms first, then MeSH ancestors (ClinicalTrials.gov), then the condition text and disease class (ISRCTN). The first rule that matches wins for that term; a study gets every treatment function any of its terms map to. Cancers are mapped by site to the department most patients would be referred to - a sensible guess, not a fact. Edit freely; kitchen/sources/trials.py writes the result to data/processed/trials/condition_mapping.json for review.
